Title: Install & enable Manage Access governance
Preconditions: itgc app installed on the test site
Steps:
1) bench --site SITE install-app itgc (if not already)
2) bench --site SITE migrate (runs after_migrate -> seeds the two protected-role tables)
3) bench --site SITE build --app itgc; bench --site SITE clear-cache
4) Open ITGC Settings; tick 'Enable Manage Access'; Save
5) Confirm the ITGC Manage Access Approval workflow is now Active
ExpectedResult: Governance ON; access_guard lockdown active; approval workflow is_active=1; Fully Restricted = [System Manager]; Approval-Gated = [ITGC Access Manager]

Title: Create fixture users
Steps:
Create Users (assign roles via bench console to avoid the lockdown):
1) SM_USER = System Manager (Administrator is fine)
2) AM_USER = 'ITGC Access Manager' role only (a department approver)
3) AM_USER2 = 'ITGC Access Manager' role (second approver for SoD)
4) SUDO_USER = NO SM, NO ITGC Access Manager initially (will be set as Sudo User)
5) REG_USER = plain system user, no special roles
6) TARGET_USER = plain system user (subject of admin actions)
ExpectedResult: Six users exist/enabled with stated roles

Title: Configure Sudo User (auto-grants AM role)
Steps:
1) ITGC Settings > Manage Access > Critical Role Protection
2) Set Sudo User = SUDO_USER; Save
3) Inspect SUDO_USER's roles
ExpectedResult: sudo_user saved AND SUDO_USER now also holds 'ITGC Access Manager' (auto-granted so it can operate the approval workflow)

Title: Create departments
Steps:
1) New Manage Access Department 'DEPT-A'; approver(Access Managers)=[AM_USER2]; Save
2) New Manage Access Department 'DEPT-B'; approver=[AM_USER]; Save
ExpectedResult: Departments exist routing normal (non-protected) approvals

Title: Create role-profile fixtures
Steps:
Via bench console (lockdown blocks UI edits):
1) Role Profile 'RP_NORMAL' roles=[Blogger]
2) Role Profile 'RP_RESTRICTED' roles=[Blogger, System Manager]
3) Role Profile 'RP_GATED' roles=[Blogger, ITGC Access Manager]
ExpectedResult: Three role profiles exist

Title: Department required to submit
Steps: 1) New Manage Access; request_type='Request Role'; request_for=REG_USER; role=Blogger; Department blank; Save
ExpectedResult: Blocked: Department is mandatory

Title: Submits when department set
Steps: 1) As DEPT-01 but Department=DEPT-A; Save
ExpectedResult: Saves; approver synced to AM_USER2

Title: Legacy blank-department draft fails on re-save
Preconditions: A draft created before department became mandatory, blank department
Steps: 1) Open the draft; edit any field; Save
ExpectedResult: Save now blocked until a Department is set (not retroactive to untouched records)

Steps: 1) Login REG_USER; New Manage Access; request_type='Request Role'; do not set request_for
ExpectedResult: request_for auto-fills to REG_USER

Title: Revoke Role does not default to self
Steps: 1) Login AM_USER; request_type='Revoke Role'; observe request_for

Title: Revoke/Disable request_for editable
Steps: 1) Login AM_USER; pick Revoke Role/Revoke Role Profile/Disable User; try editing For User

Title: Request Role For User read-only
Steps: 1) Login REG_USER; request_type='Request Role'; try editing For User
ExpectedResult: For User read-only (self only)

Title: Request type mandatory

Title: Request Role requires role

ExpectedResult: Blocked: 'Please select a Role.'

Title: Request Role Profile requires profile

Steps: 1) request_type='Disable User'; request_for=TARGET_USER; department=DEPT-A; Save

Steps: 1) request_type='Revoke Role'; request_for=TARGET_USER; role=Blogger; department=DEPT-A; Save

Steps: 1) request_type='Disable User'; request_for=TARGET_USER; department=DEPT-A; Save

Title: Sudo User can raise Revoke Role
Steps: 1) request_type='Revoke Role'; request_for=TARGET_USER; role=Blogger; department=DEPT-A; Save

ExpectedResult: Revoke Role/Revoke Role Profile/Disable User and SM-only types NOT listed

Title: Revoke options visible to Access Manager
Steps: 1) Open Request Type dropdown

Steps: 1) POST /api/resource/Manage Access request_type='Revoke Role', request_for=TARGET_USER, role=Blogger, department=DEPT-A

Title: AM cannot REQUEST System Manager (direct)
Steps: 1) request_type='Request Role'; request_for=TARGET_USER; role='System Manager'; department=DEPT-A; Save
ExpectedResult: Blocked: 'Only the Sudo User or a System Manager may request the fully-restricted role(s): System Manager.'

Title: Profile-bypass blocked: Request Role Profile pulling in System Manager
Steps: 1) request_type='Request Role Profile'; request_for=TARGET_USER; role_profile='RP_RESTRICTED'; department=DEPT-A; Save
ExpectedResult: Blocked — guard expands the profile and finds the restricted role

Title: New User assigning System Manager blocked for AM
Steps: 1) request_type='New User'; request_for=a website user; role='System Manager'; department=DEPT-A; Save

Title: System Manager hidden from Role picker for AM

Title: Restricted role visible to Sudo/SM in picker
Steps: 1) request_type='Request Role'; open Role field; search 'System'
ExpectedResult: System Manager selectable (may_grant=true)

Title: Regular/AM user CAN request ITGC Access Manager
Preconditions: Login AM_USER (or REG_USER); Sudo User configured
Steps: 1) request_type='Request Role'; request_for=TARGET_USER; role='ITGC Access Manager'; department=DEPT-A; Save
ExpectedResult: Saves successfully — approval-gated roles are requestable by anyone (this is the fix for the 'cannot see ITGC Access Manager' problem)

Title: ITGC Access Manager visible in Role picker to everyone
Steps: 1) request_type='Request Role'; open Role field; search 'ITGC Access'
ExpectedResult: ITGC Access Manager IS selectable (only fully-restricted roles are hidden)

Title: Gated request via Role Profile is requestable
Steps: 1) request_type='Request Role Profile'; request_for=TARGET_USER; role_profile='RP_GATED'; department=DEPT-A; Save
ExpectedResult: Saves — request allowed; grant still gated at approval

Title: Department AM cannot APPROVE a protected-role grant
Preconditions: AGATE-01 request pending (grants ITGC Access Manager), routed to protected approvers
Steps:
1) Login as a plain department AM (not Sudo/SM)
2) Attempt to Approve
ExpectedResult: Cannot approve: not in approver table (routing excluded them) AND before_submit would block (not Sudo/SM)

Title: Sudo User CAN approve a protected-role grant
Preconditions: AGATE-01 request pending; SUDO_USER in approver list (auto-AM-role)
Steps: 1) Login SUDO_USER; Approve
ExpectedResult: docstatus=1; ITGC Access Manager granted to TARGET_USER via apply()

Title: Approval gate enforced server-side (API bypass)
Steps: 1) As a non-Sudo/SM user with submit access, call submit via API directly
ExpectedResult: before_submit throws PermissionError — gate independent of the workflow UI

Title: Revoke of protected role is NOT approval-gated
Preconditions: Sudo configured; an active second System Manager exists
Steps: 1) AM_USER raises Revoke Role role=ITGC Access Manager (gated role is visible) for TARGET_USER; route+approve via department AM
ExpectedResult: Approval gate does not fire (revoke grants nothing). Subject to AM-gate + lockout only. NOTE: a department AM CAN approve a revoke of a gated role (de-escalation, by design)

Title: Protected-grant request routes to authorised approvers
Preconditions: SETUP-03; AGATE-01 or REST-05 request saved
Steps: 1) Inspect the read-only Approvers table on the saved request
ExpectedResult: Approvers = enabled ITGC Access Manager holders who are Sudo/SM (i.e. SUDO_USER, and any SM who also holds AM) — NOT the department AMs

Title: No Sudo User => protected request warns of no approver
Preconditions: Sudo User cleared; no System Manager holds the AM role
Steps: 1) AM_USER raises Request Role role=ITGC Access Manager; Save
ExpectedResult: Saves but shows orange alert 'No eligible approver... Set a Sudo User'; approver table empty (fail-secure, cannot be approved)

Title: Normal (non-protected) request uses department routing
Steps: 1) request_type='Request Role'; role=Blogger; department=DEPT-A; Save; inspect Approvers
ExpectedResult: Approvers=[AM_USER2] (department), not the protected-approver set

Title: Setting Sudo User grants it the AM role
Steps:
1) ITGC Settings set Sudo User=SUDO_USER; Save
2) Inspect SUDO_USER roles
ExpectedResult: SUDO_USER gains 'ITGC Access Manager' so it can act on the workflow

Title: AM role self-heals on User save
Preconditions: SUDO_USER has a Role Profile that lacks AM role
Steps:
1) Save SUDO_USER (core role-profile sync strips ad-hoc roles)
2) Inspect roles
ExpectedResult: ITGC Access Manager re-asserted after profile sync (not lost)

Title: AM role NOT stripped from former Sudo User
Preconditions: SUDO_USER currently sudo; then change Sudo User to a different account
Steps:
1) Change Sudo User=other; Save
2) Inspect old SUDO_USER roles
ExpectedResult: Old sudo KEEPS the AM role (grant-only sync; documented over-grant, never wrongly strips a legit AM)

Title: Authorisation tracks the actor at each stage
Preconditions: REST-05: Sudo raises a System Manager request; pending; a second Sudo/SM approver exists
Steps: 1) The second authorised approver approves
ExpectedResult: Request side checks requester (Sudo OK); approval side checks approver (must be Sudo/SM, not self due to SoD)

Title: Blank Sudo User: only SM may request restricted roles
Steps:
1) Clear Sudo User; Save
2) AM_USER raises Request Role role='System Manager'
ExpectedResult: Blocked (only SM can request restricted). _may_grant requires System Manager when no sudo set

Title: Sudo identity is exact-match
Preconditions: sudo_user=SUDO_USER; login as a different non-SM user
Steps: 1) Attempt to request/approve a protected role
ExpectedResult: Blocked — only the exact configured sudo_user is privileged

Title: Picker filter is UX-only; server authoritative
Steps: 1) Bypass the form; POST a request granting System Manager directly
ExpectedResult: Server still rejects (restricted request guard) — UI filter not relied on for security

Title: Sudo/SM can see restricted role to revoke it
Steps: 1) request_type='Revoke Role'; open Role field; search 'System'
ExpectedResult: System Manager selectable so authorised users can revoke it

Title: Cannot revoke last System Manager
Preconditions: Exactly ONE enabled System Manager = TARGET_USER (direct grant); login SUDO_USER
Steps: 1) request_type='Revoke Role'; request_for=TARGET_USER; role='System Manager'; department=DEPT-A; Save
ExpectedResult: Blocked: 'This would remove the last active holder of the protected role System Manager...'

Title: Cannot disable last System Manager
Preconditions: TARGET_USER sole enabled System Manager; login SUDO_USER
Steps: 1) request_type='Disable User'; request_for=TARGET_USER; department=DEPT-A; Save
ExpectedResult: Blocked — zero active SMs would remain

Title: Revoke allowed when another holder exists
Preconditions: TWO enabled System Managers (TARGET_USER + SM_USER); login SUDO_USER
Steps: 1) Revoke System Manager from TARGET_USER; Save
ExpectedResult: Saves — another active holder remains

Title: Disabled other holder => still blocked
Preconditions: TARGET_USER + a second SM who is DISABLED; login SUDO_USER
Steps: 1) Revoke System Manager from TARGET_USER
ExpectedResult: Blocked — only ENABLED holders count

Title: Re-checked at approval time
Preconditions: LOCK-03 request pending while 2 SMs exist; then the OTHER SM removed elsewhere
Steps:
1) Other SM removed
2) Approver tries to Approve original revoke
ExpectedResult: Approval now blocked — lockout re-evaluated on the approve save

Title: Revoke Role Profile last-holder block
Preconditions: TARGET_USER holds System Manager ONLY via RP_RESTRICTED, sole enabled SM; login SUDO_USER
Steps: 1) request_type='Revoke Role Profile'; request_for=TARGET_USER; role_profile='RP_RESTRICTED'; department=DEPT-A; Save
ExpectedResult: Blocked — revoking profile strips System Manager leaving no active holder

Title: Non-protected role revoke never lockout-blocked
Preconditions: TARGET_USER sole holder of Blogger; login AM_USER
Steps: 1) Revoke Role role=Blogger for TARGET_USER; Save
ExpectedResult: Saves — Blogger not protected

Title: Conservative false-block on Revoke Role Profile
Preconditions: TARGET_USER holds System Manager BOTH directly AND via RP_RESTRICTED, sole enabled SM; login SUDO_USER
Steps: 1) Revoke Role Profile RP_RESTRICTED for TARGET_USER; Save
ExpectedResult: Currently BLOCKED though the direct grant would survive (documented safe-but-strict; no provenance check)

Title: Revoke Role of a profile-supplied role is a no-op
Preconditions: TARGET_USER has System Manager via RP_RESTRICTED (not direct); another active SM exists; login SUDO_USER
Steps:
1) Revoke Role role='System Manager' for TARGET_USER; Submit
2) Save TARGET_USER; inspect roles
ExpectedResult: System Manager NOT removed: ensure_granted_roles computes to_remove = revoked - profile_roles; profile re-supplies it

Title: Grant then Revoke then Grant resolves to granted
Preconditions: Submitted records for TARGET_USER+Blogger in order: Request Role, Revoke Role, Request Role
Steps:
1) Create/approve the three in order
2) Save TARGET_USER; inspect roles
ExpectedResult: Blogger present — latest action per role wins

Title: Granted role self-heals across User save
Preconditions: Approved 'Request Role: Blogger' for a role-profile TARGET_USER whose profile lacks Blogger
Steps:
1) Save TARGET_USER (core profile sync strips ad-hoc roles)
2) Inspect roles
ExpectedResult: Blogger re-asserted by ensure_granted_roles

Title: Restricted grant needs two distinct Sudo/SM (SoD)
Preconditions: Only one Sudo/SM exists and they are the requester of a System Manager grant
Steps:
1) Sudo raises Request Role: System Manager
2) Same Sudo tries to approve
ExpectedResult: Self-approval blocked (allow_self_approval=0) and no other authorised approver => stuck. Need a 2nd Sudo/SM (correct fail-secure)

Title: Department approvers become request approvers
Steps: 1) Raise non-protected request department=DEPT-A; Save; inspect Approvers
ExpectedResult: Approvers=[AM_USER2]

Title: Sole-approver-is-requester escalates to global fallback
Preconditions: Global Access Manager set; DEPT-B=[AM_USER]; login AM_USER
Steps: 1) Raise non-protected request department=DEPT-B; Save; inspect Approvers
ExpectedResult: Global Access Manager appended as fallback (requester filtered out)

Title: Approver re-synced when department changes
Steps:
1) Raise dept=DEPT-A; check approver=AM_USER2
2) Change dept=DEPT-C; Save; check approver
ExpectedResult: Approvers re-derived to [SM_USER]

Title: Approver cannot edit request content
Preconditions: Pending request owned by AM_USER, approver=AM_USER2
Steps: 1) Login AM_USER2; change any content field; Save
ExpectedResult: Blocked (PermissionError): approvers cannot modify a request

Title: Owner can edit and resubmit own request
Preconditions: A rejected request owned by AM_USER
Steps: 1) Login AM_USER; edit role; Save; resubmit
ExpectedResult: Allowed — owner may fix and resubmit

Title: Approver cannot self-approve
Preconditions: Request raised by AM_USER2 who is also in the approver list
Steps: 1) Login AM_USER2; try Approve own request
ExpectedResult: Workflow rejects (allow_self_approval=0)

Title: Regular user sees only own/approver requests
Steps: 1) Open Manage Access list
ExpectedResult: REG_USER sees only requests they own or approve

Title: Approver opens routed request only
Preconditions: Request routed to AM_USER2; another elsewhere; login AM_USER2
Steps: 1) Open routed request by URL (ok); open unrelated by URL (denied)
ExpectedResult: Approver reads/acts on routed requests only

Title: System Manager sees everything
Steps: 1) Open Manage Access list
ExpectedResult: All requests visible

Title: Direct User role edit blocked when governance ON
Steps: 1) Open a User; add/remove a role; Save
ExpectedResult: Blocked: 'Access is governed by Manage Access...'

Title: Direct Role Profile / Custom DocPerm edit blocked
Steps: 1) Edit a Role Profile's roles via form; Save
ExpectedResult: Blocked by block_doc

Title: Break-glass: bench console bypasses lockdown
Steps: 1) bench console; modify a user's roles and save
ExpectedResult: Allowed — no HTTP request, intended break-glass

Title: Data Import is guarded
Steps: 1) Data Import that changes User roles
ExpectedResult: Blocked (frappe.flags.in_import guarded)

Title: Enabling Manage Access activates workflow
Steps:
1) Toggle enable_manage_access OFF then ON; Save each
2) Check Workflow is_active
ExpectedResult: Workflow is_active mirrors the flag (self-healing)

Title: Approved non-protected request applies on submit
Preconditions: Pending 'Request Role: Blogger' for TARGET_USER, approver=AM_USER2
Steps: 1) Login AM_USER2; Approve; inspect TARGET_USER roles
ExpectedResult: docstatus=1; Blogger granted

Title: Fresh install seeds both tiers
Steps:
1) Install itgc; bench migrate
2) ITGC Settings > Fully Restricted / Approval-Gated
ExpectedResult: Fully Restricted=[System Manager]; Approval-Gated=[ITGC Access Manager]

Title: Seeding non-destructive on re-migrate
Steps: 1) bench migrate again
ExpectedResult: Existing lists preserved (each tier seeded only when empty)

Title: Empty tier re-seeds on next migrate
Preconditions: Admin cleared ALL rows of one tier
Steps: 1) bench migrate
ExpectedResult: That tier re-seeded with its defaults (fail-secure); the other tier untouched

Title: Move a role between tiers
Steps:
1) Remove 'ITGC Access Manager' from Approval-Gated; add it to Fully Restricted; Save
2) As AM_USER try to request it
ExpectedResult: Now hidden + blocked at request (behaves as restricted). Protection is fully configurable per tier

Title: Add a custom approval-gated role
Steps:
1) Add 'Accounts Manager' to Approval-Gated; Save
2) As REG_USER request it; route+approve as Sudo
ExpectedResult: Requestable by anyone, approvable only by Sudo/SM — not hardcoded to ITGC Access Manager
